title: Prepare a conditional full clock state at one fixed admitted coupling
statement: At one sufficiently small fixed coupling and every real t>=T0, the known-classical-syndrome FULL clock Gibbs state has a polynomial(n,t,1/epsilon) coherent ideal circuit and parent gap at least1/16. Defect-count coercivity, scaled locality and finite spectral-flow circuit replace a hidden Gibbs/ground-state oracle. This does not supply the source-syndrome marginal or uniform all-temperature storage composition.

Actual full excited-clock weights p_s proportional to Tr exp(-t H_s), not a ground-energy marginal
Fixed coupling satisfies every declared lower/upper window, KP/temperature and preparation gate; t=beta Delta
